headings.usage: Use for all page titles, widget titles, and modal headers. Apply tracking-tight for sizes text-2xl and above.

body.usage: Use for standard text, labels, and descriptions.

numbers_and_data.usage: CRITICAL: Use for ALL currency amounts, account balances, and dates. Monospaced numbers ensure decimals align perfectly in tables and lists.

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro / Swiss Brutalist (Dark Mode Variant)

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Instead of standard floating cards, use border-collapse styles or crisp 1px borders (border-zinc-800) with NO drop shadows. Flat, geometric, and precise.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use ONLY for sticky headers or dropdowns: backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/80 border-b border-zinc-800. NEVER fully transparent.
visual_enhancers.corners: Subtle roundness. Use rounded-none or max rounded-md (6px) for widgets. Inputs and buttons should be rounded-md.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense internal padding for standard data (p-4 or p-6). But maintain generous padding for the main app container (p-4 md:p-8).

components.cards: Cardless aesthetic or flat bordered rectangles. bg-[#141415] border border-zinc-800. No shadows.
components.tables: Dense rows. Hover states MUST have clear contrast (hover:bg-zinc-900). Right-align all numeric/currency columns.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#F5D90A] text-black hover:bg-[#FCE64D] hover:-translate-y-[1px] transition-transform. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-700 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components. Inputs must have clear borders (border-zinc-700) and focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F5D90A]).
components.dropdowns: MUST have solid backgrounds (bg-zinc-900) with z-50. Never transparent.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all rows and cards. Buttons slightly translate up (-translate-y-[1px]).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200. NO transition-all.
motion.charts: Animate chart line drawing on load (if supported by library).

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use dark gray on darker gray.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings.
accessibility.data_testids: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-expense-btn').

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense, professional data tools. They scale better and look cleaner in technical environments.
media.empty_states: Use abstract, geometric SVG shapes or minimal Phosphor icons with text. Do not use generic 3D illustrations.

localization.currency_formatting: CRITICAL: Use Intl.NumberFormat('tr-TR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY' }). Turkey uses comma for decimals and dots for thousands (e.g., 1.250,50 ₺).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts sonner date-fns`
Configure Tailwind with the specified font families in tailwind.config.js.
Initialize Shadcn UI and add components: button, card, input, select, table, dialog, tabs.
Create a responsive sidebar or top nav for switching between Dashboard, Receivables, Expenses, and Accounts.
Ensure the chart component uses custom colors defined in 'colors' section.
Wrap the app or relevant sections in a Dark mode context/class strictly.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders instead of muddy shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY where appropriate (headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable between distinct sections. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). If images are needed, use valid web URLs or abstract SVGs.
